quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Where'd the Ingredients Go?
quest.description: Julie of the Gourmet Supremos seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Hmm... it should be around here.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, Traveler, it's you! Hehe, never expected to run into you here...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I'm here to look for ingredients. Xudong is working on new dishes, and Parvaneh is giving him ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Xudong told me that he wanted to make a sweet and soft dish for dessert based on Inazuma's Tricolor Dango. But it would take several special ingredients to do so.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Uncle Munehisa went into town to buy some Lavender Melons. I'm here to gather what they call Sakura Blooms.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Although I have gathered some, it's still not enough yet. I wanted to go search ahead, but it's crawling with monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Traveler, please. Could you please help me bring three Sakura Blooms back?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Thank you! I'll treat you to something great when you get back!

choices.text: These monsters shouldn't be a trouble for you, right?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Well, that would generally be the case...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: But, hmm, how do I put this? If I really have to fight against those monsters, I'll definitely forget about the ingredient-gathering mission.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: I've been like this ever since I was in Mondstadt. Whenever I was dealing with monsters, I would forget about everything else.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Only after I completely defeated the monsters would I remember that I still had an assignment that required my attention... That's how I failed so many assignments...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You really hate monsters, don't you...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Hate them? No, not really... Actually, I find fighting them really fun...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Have you ever had that feeling, when you don't need to think about anything but defeating monsters? It's amazing.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Well, let's not dwell on that. So, please help me out with the Sakura Bloom-gathering mission, thanks!

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: I'll treat you to something great when you get back!

talks.objective: Look for three Fresh Sakura Blooms

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Have you gathered all the Sakura Blooms?

talks.objective: Give three Fresh Sakura Blooms to Julie

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Alright, these will do. Thanks! If it wasn't for you, I would have had to charge in there and deal with those monsters myself.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: If that had happened, I really don't know when I would have remembered that I was tasked with gathering Sakura Blooms again...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for your help. Please take these Chicken-Mushroom Skewers. Miss Lynn taught me how to make this classic adventurers' dish.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I'll bring these Sakura Blooms back to Xudong. I wonder what kind of goodies he'll come up with...
